capabilities: Add folder structure nodes to graph views
Display file headings as foldable graph nodes
Include or exclude specific folders from the graph
Render ghost nodes for unresolved folder, file, and heading links
Choose how heading wikilinks are drawn between files and headings
extras: Pre-fills the graph search with path filters via Ctrl/Cmd+click; ghost node clicks create the missing content and navigate to it.
intentEvidence: By enabling this extension, all you graphs will add your vault folder structure into their view.
problem: Obsidian's graph view only shows note links, so vaults organized with folders have no visual representation of that hierarchy.
summary: Graph view extension that adds your vault's folder structure and file headings as nodes in Obsidian graphs.
